question: An air-cored toroid (relative permeability $\mu_r=1$) has a rectangular cross-section. Its inner radius is $a$, outer radius is $b$, and height (axial length) is $h$. The toroid is tightly wound with $N$ turns carrying a steady current $I$. Neglect leakage/fringing so that the magnetic field exists only inside the core region $a<r<b$. Calculate the magnetic flux $\Phi_B$ through the cross-sectional area of the toroid (i.e., through the rectangular core area of height $h$ and radial thickness $b-a$).
